description: Explicit Rust-local acquisition for the reviewed/default policy or one explicitly selected metadata catalog. Reviewed unknown tables retain metadata-only claims; catalog results require full schema and row decoding. Acquisition does not establish runtime acceptance.

schema_selection.reviewed: Default two reviewed tables or the unchanged explicit-list policy: known schemas decode; unknown tables publish complete metadata-only bytes with false/null record claims.
schema_selection.catalog: Explicit manifest plus --schema-catalog pinned-metadata-v1, or wowdbdefs-70205-v1 for build 70205; every name/ID must resolve exactly and every complete artifact requires schema+record decode.

version_dispatch.2: Unchanged native reviewed/default and metadata-only contract.
version_dispatch.3: Unchanged native explicit pinned catalog contract.
version_dispatch.4: Explicit Rust-local acquisition; schema_selection independently preserves reviewed or catalog semantics.

invariants: Open exactly one acquisition session before creating output; reuse it for every read.
Profile contains all effective store limits, explicit index/ROOT layouts, offline mode and full CKey MD5 validation; only nine EKey prefix bytes are authenticated.
1..16 MiB effective per-file ceiling; option, acquisition and artifact claims must agree; batch limit 256 MiB and at most256entries.
Create the real incomplete marker before reads; remove it only after a fully complete report and manifest publish.
InputChanged or a changed observed build is fatal: retain marker and partial artifacts, issue no more reads; ordinary entry failure may continue but cannot produce a complete run.
Native v2/v3 bytes and schema/record claim semantics remain unchanged; backend selection does not upgrade metadata-only claims.
V4 verifier validates the acquisition profile and companion report offline, and recomputes the existing inventory, identity and claimed-row checks.
Catalog schema provenance remains fixed and mandatory only when schema_selection=catalog.
No client bytes, paths, keys, remote fallback or full runtime acceptance claim.
wowdbdefs-70205-v1 accepts only build 70205; the catalog identity does not authenticate local client acquisition.

acquisition.native_default: Unchanged v2/v3; layout/limit options are rejected with native. A binary without native rejects its default before client/output IO. Native report.json remains version1; Rust-local uses report_version2. The verifier result keeps version1 because its shape is unchanged.
